stories.title: India's first blue bond pulled on launch day
stories.body: Sagarmala Finance Corporation withdrew the country's maiden blue bond on 28 Sept 2026 after receiving coupon bids higher than the expected below-8% level, Managing Director L.V.S. Sudhakar Babu confirmed. The up-to-₹600 crore 10-year issue (₹100 crore base + ₹500 crore greenshoe, rated AA+ by ICRA/CARE, arranged by SBI Capital Markets) had been scheduled for 28 Sept — covered in yesterday's edition. Rising borrowing costs bit elsewhere too: SIDBI cancelled a ₹60-billion note sale (bids 7.6–8.1%) and Power Grid accepted only ₹20 billion of a planned ₹50 billion raise. Borrowing costs are rising on expectations the RBI will tighten later this year to contain oil-price-driven inflation.

stories.title: Supreme Court refuses to stay 0.4% MDR on UPI above ₹2,000
stories.body: the Supreme Court declined to stay the Centre's framework under which a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate will apply to person-to-merchant UPI payments above ₹2,000 from 15 October 2026. UPI has historically been MDR-free; the move reopens the zero-MDR debate (MDR was withdrawn in 2020) — a hot Bank-prelims current-affairs item on digital payments.

stories.title: UFBU strike deferred: no 28–30 Sept bank strike
stories.body: the nationwide three-day strike called by the United Forum of Bank Unions was deferred after late-night talks on 27 Sept between the UFBU and the Indian Banks' Association (IBA) (update to yesterday's edition). The IBA agreed to a joint high-level committee to examine the long-pending demand for a five-day banking week and other issues including the performance-linked incentive scheme; banks are operating normally.

stories.title: Fitch raises India's FY27 growth forecast to 6.9%
stories.body: Fitch Ratings lifted its FY2026-27 GDP projection to 6.9% from 6.4% (stronger-than-expected 7.8% June-quarter growth; S&P and Moody's are at 7%). It still expects momentum to moderate and the RBI to hike the policy rate 25 bps in October to 5.5%, with a further rise to 5.75% in early 2027 — broadly matching HSBC's two-hike call carried yesterday. Fitch expects investment to rise over 10% and non-food credit growth touched 19% YoY in July.

stories.title: NHSRCL launches first 100-metre steel bridge for the bullet train
stories.body: the National High Speed Rail Corporation launched the first 100-metre-long steel bridge for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor in Maharashtra (reported 28–29 Sept). The bridge weighs around 1,405 tonnes — a flagship milestone for the MAHSR project, whose Japanese Shinkansen-based trains are targeted at 320 km/h.

stories.title: Nilekani task force on exam reforms consults K. Radhakrishnan
stories.body: the Nandan Nilekani-led task force on exam reforms consulted former ISRO chairman K. Radhakrishnan, who headed the committee constituted by the Centre after the 2024 NEET-UG paper leak (reported 29 Sept). The consultation signals the task force is building on the Radhakrishnan committee's recommendations — exam-integrity architecture is a recurring GS-2/Polity-reform theme.

stories.title: Foreign Secretary Misri meets US Congressional delegation
stories.body: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri met a bipartisan US Congressional delegation led by Representative Brian Mast (reported 29 Sept), discussing the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, India-US ties, energy security, counter-terrorism and freedom of navigation. Watch for GS-2 spillover: India's oil-buying latitude under sanctions scrutiny.

stories.title: Yudh Abhyas 2026: India-US precision-strike exercise at Mahajan
stories.body: on 26 Sept, the Indian and US Armies conducted a precision-strike exercise using the Indian-made Sky-Striker UAV at the Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan, as part of the 22nd edition of Yudh Abhyas (reported 27–29 Sept). This year's exercise focused on joint combat capabilities in mountainous and semi-mountainous terrain, showcasing indigenous drones and unmanned systems.

stories.title: Project 15B: the Indian Navy's newest stealth destroyer, INS Surat
stories.body: today's roundups recap INS Surat, the fourth and final Visakhapatnam-class destroyer under Project 15B (commissioned January 2025 by PM Modi; designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau, built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders). Exam-ready facts: 75% indigenous content, India's first AI-enabled warship, 7,400-tonne displacement, BrahMos + Barak-8 armament; built after INS Visakhapatnam, Mormugao and Imphal.

stories.title: India–Vietnam bilateral exercise (VINBAX) in focus
stories.body: the 29 Sept roundup flags the India–Vietnam bilateral military exercise on counter-terrorism and jungle warfare under UN mandates (FAQ answer confirms the partner nation as Vietnam). VINBAX is the only annual field UN-peacekeeping exercise India conducts with Vietnam — a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership anchor under the Act East policy.

stories.title: ICAR × NDDB pact for indigenous cattle genomics
stories.body: the Indian Council of Agricultural Research signed a strategic pact with the National Dairy Development Board to scale up genomic selection in indigenous cattle breeds, accelerating genetic advancement and milk productivity (reported in the 29 Sept roundup). Note the pairing: ICAR (research) with NDDB (the Anand-headquartered dairy cooperative body under the Ministry of Cooperation).

stories.title: Asian Games 2026: Sable finishes 4th; Miura breaks his Games record
stories.body: Avinash Sable missed the steeplechase medal, finishing 4th in 8:21.67 (season best) in the men's 3000m steeplechase final on 28 Sept; Japan's Ryuji Miura pulled clear to win and broke the Asian Games record Sable had set at the previous edition.

stories.title: Boxing: Kapil Pokhariya assures India a medal
stories.body: Kapil Pokhariya beat Korea's Gichae Kim 5-0 in the men's 90kg quarter-final on 28 Sept, reaching the semi-final and guaranteeing an Asian Games boxing medal.

stories.title: Day 11 today (29 Sept): semi-finals on cards
stories.body: after the 28 Sept rain-out, India meet the Sri Lanka–Nepal quarter-final winner in the men's cricket semi-final today; check today's evening games for the final tally. India's tally stood at 39 (4G/17S/18B), 12th, after Day 10 — see the 28 Sept evening edition for the full Day 10 athletics haul.
